# Seattle Christmas Lights

> We hang professional Christmas lights on homes across Seattle and the Eastside, then take them down and store them when the season's over. Based in Kenmore, WA. Licensed, bonded and insured.

## Pricing
- Installs start at $800

## What's included
- Durable commercial grade lights and equipment, leased for the season
- Install on rooflines, trees, bushes and walkways
- Free fixes if anything goes out during the season
- Takedown in January
- Storage until next year

## Contact
- Phone: (425) 448-4998 (call or text 7am to 7pm, every day)
- Quote form: https://lightseattle.com/#quote
